mintAuthority.summary: Unity USD (UUSD) is an upgradeable Ownable proxy ERC-20 on BSC operated by Anything Labs; live reads resolve the token owner to a 4/7 Safe that can mint/burn directly and controls the proxy-admin ownership chain.

controls.label: UUSD owner Safe
controls.evidence: BSC owner() returned this Safe at block 103627514. RPC getOwners() decoded 7 owners (matching stored list); storage slot 4 returned threshold 4. No enabled modules; zero guard confirmed. The owner can mint/burn directly under the UUSD implementation.

controls.label: UUSD proxy-admin ownership chain
controls.evidence: EIP-1967 proxy-admin slot returned this contract; owner() returned 0x2D49CB4194dFa42d711699a87C10C6BbC05d94b6 (reconfirmed at BSC block 103627514), whose owner() resolves to the same 4/7 Safe (0x009c5467667dcD2Ab8C310E84B105cC0b570a8F4). ProxyAdmin is a non-multisig upgrader contract; modules not applicable.

review.evidence: BSC block 103627514: token owner() = 0x009c5467667dcD2Ab8C310E84B105cC0b570a8F4 (4/7 Safe, 7 owners confirmed via RPC getOwners, threshold 4 via storage slot 4); proxy-admin chain confirmed (EIP-1967 slot → 0x61108af7…, owner → 0x2D49CB4…, owner → same Safe). All mint-capable surfaces on-chain confirmed. Reserve backing is undisclosed by issuer but does not affect mint-path verification. UUSD (Anything Labs) is a BSC protocol with no disclosed registered entity or jurisdiction; its site, whitepaper and GitHub disclose no reserve composition, custodian, or independent attestation (only smart-contract security scanners such as SlowMist and GoPlus), so reconciliation is unknown. No financial regulator or licence for Anything Labs or UUSD was found, so supervision is none. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: the issuer Safe can mint directly and upgrade mint logic without an evidenced bound, while reserve reconciliation remains undisclosed. Re-opened the Anything Labs UUSD site, issuance/developer pages, whitepaper, and smart-contract repository: these describe audited contracts and verifiable on-chain issuance but provide no dated reserve snapshot, reserve-liability reconciliation, named attestor, or recurring reserve report, so reconciliation remains unknown.
